Keep spectra matching retained feature identifiers

mc_filter_mgf.Rd

Subset a Spectra object using the feature IDs in a filtered result or a supplied table.

mc_filter_mgf(spectra, table, match_col = NULL, id_field = "acquisitionNum")

Arguments

spectra

A Spectra object to subset.

table

A metabocensor_result or a data frame identifying the features to retain.

match_col

Feature-ID column. With a result object, NULL uses its selected ID column; with a data frame, NULL uses the first column. An explicit name for a result object refers to the input-format exported table.

id_field

Spectrum metadata field containing feature IDs. Default: "acquisitionNum".

Details

IDs are trimmed and matched as exact strings or finite numeric equivalents; for example, 12 and 12.0 match. Every spectrum with a matching ID is retained, including multiple spectra per feature. No MS-level restriction or spectral merging is performed. If no IDs match, an empty Spectra object is returned with a warning.

Value

A subset of the supplied Spectra object.

See also

mc_read_mgf, mc_write_mgf, mc_export

Examples

if (FALSE) {
# The peak table and labels are bundled; only MGF requires internet.
peak_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "orbi_iimn_gnps_quant.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported <- mc_prepare(
  peak_file, type = "mzmine",
  sample_keywords = c(".mzML", "Peak area")
)
metadata_file <- system.file(
  "extdata", "metadata.csv",
  package = "MetaboCensoR", mustWork = TRUE
)
imported$labels <- mc_labels_from_metadata(
  metadata_file, sample_names = imported$sample_cols,
  sample_col = "Sample name", label_col = "Label"
)
after_blank <- mc_filter_blank(
  imported, groups = "Blank", mode = "mean_cutoff", cutoff = 0.10
)
mgf_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plyush1993/",
  "MetaboCensoR_Examples/main/orbi/orbi_iimn_gnps.mgf"
)
mgf_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".mgf")
download.file(mgf_url, mgf_file, mode = "wb")
spectra <- mc_read_mgf(mgf_file)
filtered_spectra <- mc_filter_mgf(spectra, after_blank)
length(filtered_spectra)
}
